`CHANGELOG.md`:

```md
# Changelog

All notable changes to hiumod. Versions follow [semantic versioning](https://semver.org/).

Every release records the Steam build it was verified on. Steam's `buildid` is in
`steamapps\appmanifest_1620730.acf`, and `hiumod doctor` prints it. What the tool relies on in the
game, and what an update can break, is in [`.spec/ANCHORS.md`](.spec/ANCHORS.md).

## Unreleased — 0.2.2

### Changed

- The console opens and closes with <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>&#96;</kbd> (showing the panel if it is
  hidden), instead of a header button that appeared only over a game menu. The header shows the
  panel's and the console's keys as keycaps, written as the keys pressed (` and Shift+`: "~" is
  another key on some layouts).
- The key pickers no longer offer the game's <kbd>F1</kbd> (HUD) and <kbd>F7</kbd> (photo mode) or
  Steam's <kbd>F12</kbd> (screenshot); a saved key on one goes back to the defaults.
- New default keys, next to the game's F1: <kbd>F2</kbd> map display, <kbd>F3</kbd> compass,
  <kbd>F4</kbd> next goal, <kbd>F5</kbd> pin (were F9, F10, F11, F6). If you never changed them, they
  move to the new keys by themselves; keys you chose stay.

### Diagnostics

- The engine logs what the Haze links are read from (`haze probe:` lines in `hiumod.log`): no link
  was found in a first fight, and these lines show why.

## 0.2.1 — 2026-10-04

Verified on Steam build **24045435**, where `hiumod doctor` passes every check.

### Fixed

- Updating from the footer stopped after the download with "update failed": the zip's unpacker
  (`tar.exe`) could not start from the panel, which runs without a console. It now gets its own
  input and output, as the download does. From 0.2.0 itself the button still fails: download this
  release by hand once (the footer's "What's new" link opens it); updates work from 0.2.1 on.

## 0.2.0 — 2026-10-04

Verified on Steam build **24045435**, where `hiumod doctor` passes every check.

### Panel

- A **Now** page, where the panel opens after a break: what was going on last time, the good deeds
  about to be missed, what is left in this region by kind, and which other regions are worth a trip.
- A **Puzzles** page: this region's puzzles (those nearby first, with the answer the game holds),
  Lymbic locks and the vaults, moved out of the Guide and Collect pages.
- A **Help** page beside Now at the top of the sidebar: first steps, every page in a line (press to
  open it), the keys as set, and what to do when something is off.
- Dashboard look: the Now page opens on a hero with a live map of the region, its name and six KPI
  tiles, and other regions as a bar chart; Collect and Puzzles open on progress rings; collections
  and enemy groups have progress bars; good deeds, mysteries and timeloops are rings.
- The same look on every page: the Guide target as a large panel with its distance; quests with a
  progress bar each; Clues and Help with KPI tiles and numbered steps; cheats, saves and the debug
  checks as aligned rows with status chips; achievements with progress bars; Map settings as form
  rows. Long explanations moved into hover text.
- The panel runs once: starting it again brings the running one to the front. It has a tray icon
  (click to show or hide, right-click to quit, which restores the originals as × does).
- The panel stays inside the screen when moved, restored or grown; the console's command line is no
  longer cut off; the console, and its button in the panel's header, show only over a game menu.
- The Map page has a legend card of the maps' lines and colours, as drawn with the settings now.
- The big map covers the whole screen, centred on the hero and fading out toward the edges; its
  radius, at most 400 m (the minimap's too), is measured to the screen's short side with a margin above and below, and
  its lines, icons and dots are drawn at full resolution. The minimap and big map cards
  each preview their own map.
- The big map moves smoothly: the hero's position glides between readings, the map is drawn about
  30 times a second, and a frame costs a tenth of what it did (its ground slides instead of being
  redrawn, and is redrawn on a thread of its own; the trail draws only its latest stretch).
- The panel and its tray icon carry the mod's mark instead of Windows' generic icon.
- The console and its header button appear as soon as a game menu opens, without clicking back and
  forth; minimising the panel hides it and gives the keyboard back to the game.
- A footer across the panel: restore all, "Keep settings", the version, an update from GitHub
  releases (checked at start; downloaded and applied when you ask), GitHub and the copyright.
- A splash while the panel starts: it shows until the game, its data and your kept cheats are ready
  and the panel has laid itself out, so the panel appears finished.
- The pages are regrouped so each answers one question: NPCs with more to tell moved to Clues, pins
  to Guide, the shard budget is its own card on Collect, the nearby puzzles and the puzzle list are
  one card, the secrets ring shows only on Quests, and the sidebar groups the pages as Play, Finding
  the way and System.
- Hazes are linked on the maps: a thin violet line from each Haze to the Hollow Walkers it keeps
  alive, so you can see which to kill first (in the legend while enemies are shown).
- Places the game names only by an internal trigger ("AcasaHermitTombFullyOpened") are named in the
  game's language, from its own text: the Datapad entry their facts are about; else the good deed,
  mystery or timeloop their tags belong to (begun or not, with the steps between found by the tags
  handed out together, or a telling word shared); else the place their name holds
  (`Universal_Location_…`) or this region; what they mark ("opened", "done") follows after a dot.
  A Lymbic rod's pickup has the rod's name.
- Both sides of the panel have the same margin; the achievements list's order and "show unlocked"
  switches no longer squeeze each other.
- Long lists can be grouped: places by kind, achievements by kind (story, deeds and mysteries,
  combat, gear, research and collections).
- The map's lines, outlines and terrain edges are antialiased.
- The map's background, lines and icons each have their own opacity, with presets (Solid,
  Balanced, Subtle, Icons only).
- The quest tracker sits at the top right under the minimap, clear of the game's pop-ups.
- Cards keep one gap everywhere, also between cards stacked in one column.
- The map's water now reaches its real shore instead of stopping at the game's water boxes, and
  the big map's ground is drawn as dots with gaps between them so the game shows through (on by
  default); icons, the route and pins stay solid.
- Scrolling is visible: solid scroll bars and a fade at an edge that hides more. Other regions are
  chips; puzzles and timeloops no longer show internal names.
- States read at a glance: chips for "opens now", covered or short, soon or later, a vault's state;
  keys as keycaps; card headers without the accent rail.
- One look per role: press a line to be guided there (no separate Guide buttons), one small
  reveal button at most per line, normal-size action buttons, and switches instead of checkboxes,
  sized to the text beside them.
- The cheat groups sit below the pages in the sidebar and start folded, their heading counting the
  cheats on.

### Guide

- **Region ledger:** counts of quest places, hand-overs, puzzles, Lymbic locks, vault doors,
  collectibles, enemy groups and NPCs with more to tell, per region — counts only, nothing named.
- **Trip planner:** other regions sorted by what you can do there right now.
- **Lymbic locks:** the rods each lock takes and which you hold; each missing rod shows how far its
  pickup is (up or down too); press a lock or a missing rod to be guided there.
- **Previously:** where the last session ended and the quest you were following.
- **Height:** every distance in the panel's lists shows ↑/↓ when the place is 3 m or more above or
  below you.
- **Clues:** a new page with the followed quest's Datapad entries — who and what it involves, and
  what you know of each — and a search over everything you know and hold, in the game's language.
  The game's text is read once more for it (`facts.tsv`).
- **Shard budget:** a card on Collect shows what *Good Vibrations*, *Accessorizing* and *To the
  Teeth* still cost in shards by the game's own recipes, from the weapons and gear you hold, whether
  your shards cover it, and how many timeloops are still open. The game's crafting table is read once
  more for it (`recipes.json`, `doctor tables`).
- **Completion board:** opening a sort in the collection card shows how many are left in each other
  region, most first.

## 0.1.0 — 2026-10-03

The first release. Verified on Steam build **24045435**, where `hiumod doctor` passes every check.

### Attaching

- Runs beside the game as its own process and reads its memory; no game file is modified.
- No per-build offsets for the engine: the name pool and `GEngine` are found on every attach, the
  FField layout is chosen from known candidates, and the path to the hero is learned from the
  engine's reflection by property name.
- Writes go only to the hero, behind a gate that closes for loading screens, menus and cinematics;
  held cheats pause while it is closed. Originals are written to disk before anything changes and are
  put back on switch-off, on closing the panel, or with `hiumod restore`.
- A warning when the game's build differs from the one the release was verified on.

### Cheats

Twelve, each seen working in play: refilled health (`god`) and stamina, walking speed, the hero's own
speed, game speed, enemy speed, frail enemies, consumables that do not run out, shard stacks,
a weapon-XP multiplier, five saved positions, and a ghost mode for getting past enemies. Three more
(Lymbic energy, Lymbic cost, skill cooldown) are in the table but not yet tried. Damage, defence,
healing, cooldown and XP coefficients cannot be changed from outside the game and are not offered —
see [`.spec/CHEATS.md`](.spec/CHEATS.md).

### Map

- A click-through minimap and a big map (F9 cycles minimap → big map → off), hidden while a game menu
  is open.
- Drawn from the world itself: walls and floors from the level's static meshes, terrain shading and
  contour lines from the landscape heightfields, floors above and below faded.
- Your trail, 26 kinds of icons (enemies by family, items by sort, loot, NPCs, doors, puzzles, vaults,
  save points, enemy groups) and 24 kinds of pins you place yourself (F6); each kind can be hidden.
- An outline style with a clear background for the big map, and adjustable radius, opacity and icon
  size.

### Guide

- A compass strip at the top of the screen (F10) with distance and height to the target.
- Goals worked out from what your save knows and what each place in the world still gives; F11 moves
  to the next one, and goals finished out of sight can be skipped.
- Walking routes on the game's own navmesh, falling back to a grid round collision shapes, deadly
  water and slopes over 45°. Goals behind closed doors and puzzles lead to what opens them first.

### Quests and collections

- A quest tracker and journal: main quests, good deeds, mysteries and timeloops by their real names,
  following the save live. Follow a quest to be guided to what it still needs, here and in other
  regions.
- Good deeds you can still miss, with the story point they fail at, and the advised keystone order.
- Hand-overs: NPCs who want an item you carry.
- Every dial, keypad and item-placement puzzle with its answer, the six Vaults of Forbidden Knowledge
  with their codes drawn as the game's symbols, and the enemy groups left per region for the
  every-Hollow achievement — every answer hidden until you ask.
- Collectibles per region, NPCs with more to tell, and your Steam achievements with progress.
- Each game save is copied to `Mods\backups` (the last 20).

### Game data

- The guide's data is read from your own game files by the bundled survey tool — automatically, once
  you control the hero, and again when the Steam build changes. Nothing from the game is shipped.
- When the .NET 8 runtime the survey tool needs is missing, the panel offers to install it: through
  winget, or without administrator rights into the game's `Mods` folder.

### Languages

- Follows the game's text language, in all twelve it ships: English, Korean, Japanese, Simplified
  Chinese, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Polish, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian and Turkish.
- Names of places, people and items come from the game's own translations on your machine; the mod's
  own text was localized per language against the game's terms.

### Panel and command line

- A panel (backquote key) with cheats by tab and pages for the map, guide, quests, collections, saves
  and debugging, and a drop-down console that runs the CLI.
- `hiumod doctor` (with `inspect`, `find`, `dump`, `watch`, `scan`, `saves`, `survey`), `list`, `get`,
  `set`, `hold`, `restore`, `pose`.

### Project

- A website in twelve languages with an introduction video, and a release workflow that builds the
  zip on Windows, checks that nothing from the game is in it, and publishes a SHA-256.

```

`Cargo.toml`:

```toml
[package]
name = "hiumod"
version = "0.2.1"
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.82"
description = "A companion for Hell Is Us on PC: minimap, quest guide, puzzle answers and single-player cheats — no game files modified"
license = "MIT"
repository = "https://github.com/myso-kr/hell-is-us-mod"

[[bin]]
name = "hiumod"
path = "src/main.rs"

[target.'cfg(windows)'.dependencies]
# The overlay. glow rather than wgpu: one small OpenGL context is all a panel needs.
eframe = { version = "0.36", default-features = false, features = ["glow", "default_fonts", "accesskit"] }
# CSS Flexbox and Grid for the panel (taffy, via egui): MIT.
egui_taffy = "0.14"
raw-window-handle = "0.6"
# update.rs: checking a downloaded release against its .sha256. Pure Rust, MIT/Apache-2.0.
sha2 = { version = "0.10", default-features = false }
windows-sys = { version = "0.59", features = [
    "Win32_Foundation",
    "Win32_Graphics_Gdi",
    "Win32_System_LibraryLoader",
    "Win32_System_Memory",
    "Win32_UI_WindowsAndMessaging",
    "Win32_UI_Input_KeyboardAndMouse",
    "Win32_System_Console",
    "Win32_System_Diagnostics_Debug",
    "Win32_System_Diagnostics_ToolHelp",
    "Win32_System_SystemInformation",
    "Win32_System_Threading",
    "Win32_System_ProcessStatus",
    "Win32_System_Registry",
    # tray.rs: the notification-area icon, and the one-panel mutex.
    "Win32_UI_Shell",
    "Win32_Security",
] }

[profile.release]
opt-level = "z"
lto = true
codegen-units = 1
panic = "abort"
strip = true

[dependencies]
resvg = { version = "0.45", default-features = false }
serde_json = "1"

```

`NOTICE`:

```
Hell Is Us — mod

Unofficial fan-made tool. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Rogue Factor or Nacon.
"Hell is Us" is a trademark of its owners.

This repository contains no game code, text or assets. It reads and writes the
memory of a copy of the game the user runs themselves, for single-player play.

Cheats can put a save into states ordinary play cannot reach, and Steam
achievements earned while cheating are not blocked. Back up your save.
Provided as is, with no warranty.
```

`README.md`:

```md
# hiumod — a companion for *Hell Is Us*

[![▶ The 31-second introduction: the world becomes a minimap, the quest tracker follows the story, a vault answer is revealed, twelve languages](docs/assets/media/poster.jpg)](https://myso-kr.github.io/hell-is-us-mod/assets/media/hiumod-intro.webm)

<sub>▶ [Watch the introduction](https://myso-kr.github.io/hell-is-us-mod/assets/media/hiumod-intro.webm) (WebM, 31 s, silent) · [MP4](https://myso-kr.github.io/hell-is-us-mod/assets/media/hiumod-intro.mp4)</sub>

A live minimap, a quest tracker and story guide, every vault and puzzle answer, and
collectible checklists for *Hell Is Us* on PC — plus a few single-player cheats.
It runs beside the game and reads its memory. **No game files are modified.**

[![CI](https://github.com/myso-kr/hell-is-us-mod/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/myso-kr/hell-is-us-mod/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/myso-kr/hell-is-us-mod?color=5a9ce6)](https://github.com/myso-kr/hell-is-us-mod/releases/latest)
[![Steam build](https://img.shields.io/badge/verified%20on-Steam%20build%2024045435-5a9ce6)](CHANGELOG.md)
[![Languages](https://img.shields.io/badge/languages-12-8b96a3)](#languages)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/code-MIT-8b96a3)](LICENSE)

> **Unofficial fan-made tool.** Not affiliated with or endorsed by Rogue Factor or
> Nacon. Requires a legitimately purchased copy of the game; this repository contains
> no game code, text or assets. Steam achievements are **not** blocked. Cheats can
> corrupt your save, so back it up first. Provided as is, with no warranty.
> See [NOTICE](NOTICE).

## Quick start

1. **Download** `hiumod-<version>.zip` from [Releases](https://github.com/myso-kr/hell-is-us-mod/releases/latest)
   and unzip it anywhere. It only ever writes to `<game folder>\Mods\`.
2. **Run `hiumod.exe`.** It starts the game through Steam if needed, attaches once you
   are in, and closes when the game does. Play windowed or borderless.
3. **Press <kbd>&#96;</kbd>** (left of <kbd>1</kbd>) for the panel. The first time you
   control the hero, it reads the game's maps and text by itself (about two minutes).
   That needs the [.NET 8 runtime](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download/dotnet/8.0);
   if it's missing, the panel offers to install it — through winget, or without
   administrator rights into the game's `Mods` folder if winget can't.

**Status:** attaches to Steam build `24045435`, where `doctor` passes every check.
Twelve cheats are verified in play; the three not yet tried say *unverified* in the
panel until someone confirms them (see [CHEATS.md](.spec/CHEATS.md)).

## What it does

*Hell Is Us* has no map, no compass and no quest markers by design. hiumod puts them
back for the nights you want them — and every answer starts hidden.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Minimap and big map** | Walls and floors from the level's geometry, shaded terrain and contours, floors above and below faded, your trail, 26 kinds of icons and 24 kinds of pins you place yourself |
| **Compass and guide** | Works the next goal out from what your save knows and what each place still holds, then routes there along the game's own navmesh, with distance and height |
| **Quest tracker** | Main quests, good deeds, mysteries and timeloops by their real names; what the followed quest still needs; good deeds you can still miss, and before when |
| **Vaults and puzzles** | Every dial, keypad and item placement, and the six Vaults of Forbidden Knowledge drawn as the game's own symbols — each behind *Show answer* |
| **Collect** | Collectibles per region, enemy groups left for the every-Hollow achievement, NPCs with more to tell, Steam achievements with progress |
| **Saves** | Each game save copied to `Mods\backups` (the last 20) |
| **Cheats** | Health, stamina, Lymbic energy, speed, time scale, frail enemies, consumables, weapon XP, saved positions — off until switched on, put back when switched off |

Every overlay hides while a game menu is open.

### Keys

| Key | |
|---|---|
| <kbd>&#96;</kbd> | show or hide the panel |
| <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>&#96;</kbd> | open or close the console (for checking things) |
| <kbd>F2</kbd> | minimap → big map → off |
| <kbd>F3</kbd> | compass |
| <kbd>F4</kbd> | guide to the next goal |
| <kbd>F5</kbd> | place or remove a pin |

The function keys can be changed on the panel's Map page. The game's own <kbd>F1</kbd> (HUD) and
<kbd>F7</kbd> (photo mode) and Steam's <kbd>F12</kbd> (screenshot) are left to them: the panel does
not offer them.

## Languages

The mod speaks the game's language. It follows the game's own text setting in all
twelve languages the game ships — English, Korean, Japanese, Simplified Chinese,
German, French, Spanish, Italian, Polish, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian and Turkish —
and takes the names of places, people and items from the game's translations on your
machine. Each language had a native-speaker pass against the game's own terms.

## Command line

```
hiumod doctor          # checks everything, writes nothing — load a save first
hiumod doctor survey   # the guide's data from your game files (the panel does this itself)
hiumod hold god stamina speed=1200  # until Ctrl+C, then puts things back
hiumod restore         # if a hold was killed rather than stopped
hiumod help            # every command
```

The same commands work in the panel's console.

## How it finds its way in

The tool stores no offsets. Each time it attaches:

1. It scans the game image's writable data for the engine's name pool and for
   `GEngine`. Each must turn up exactly once.
2. It reads the engine's own reflection to learn the path to the player:
   `GameInstance → LocalPlayers[0] → PlayerController → Pawn`, then the pawn's
   `AbilitySystemComponent → SpawnedAttributes`.
3. It finds each attribute by the game's own name, such as `EnduranceCap` or
   `LymbicEnergy`.

So a Steam patch only breaks something when it renames something, and `doctor` says
which name went missing.

### Safety rules the code keeps

- **The hero gate.** Nothing is written unless the controlled pawn is the hero, a
  `CharlieCharacterHero`. Loading screens, menus and cinematics close the gate; held
  cheats pause while it is closed rather than being dropped.
- **Every write lands on an attribute or nowhere.** An attribute must be declared
  16 bytes (an `FGameplayAttributeData`) and start with the vtable all attributes
  share, inside the game image.
- **Originals go to disk first.** `originals.txt` is written before anything is
  overwritten. Switching off, closing the panel or running `restore` puts them back.

## Building

```
cargo test                       # unit and integration tests, no game needed
cargo build --release
powershell tools/package.ps1     # dist\hiumod-<version>.zip: the exe, the survey tool, the documents
python tools/site/build.py       # the website in docs/ (GitHub Pages: main /docs)
```

The survey tool (`tools/survey`, C# with CUE4Parse) needs the .NET 8 SDK to build.

**Releasing.** Rename the newest `CHANGELOG.md` heading from `Unreleased — X.Y.Z` to
`X.Y.Z`, set the same version in `Cargo.toml`, then
`git tag vX.Y.Z && git push origin vX.Y.Z`. [`release.yml`](.github/workflows/release.yml)
checks that the three agree, builds the zip on Windows, checks that nothing from the
game is in it, and publishes it with the verified Steam build, install steps, the
changelog section and a SHA-256.

## FAQ

**Is there a map in *Hell Is Us*?** No. By design the game has no map, compass or
quest markers. hiumod adds an optional minimap overlay and a quest tracker on PC.

**Can I get banned?** *Hell Is Us* is single-player with no anti-cheat and no online
play, and hiumod changes no game files. As with any third-party tool, use it at your
own discretion.

**The game updated and something broke.** Run `hiumod doctor`; it names anything that
moved. Run `doctor survey` again for the guide's data, and open an issue with the
doctor output if it stays broken.
```

`THIRD-PARTY.md`:

```md
# Third-party

## dungeons2-mod

Most of this code base was copied from the author's own Minecraft Dungeons II mod
(`myso-kr/minecraft-dungeons-2-mod`, MIT) and adapted. That includes the name-pool
reader, attribute sessions, hold/restore, the panel and the CLI.

## Attribute names

The attribute names in `src/cheats.rs`, such as `EnduranceCap` and `LymbicEnergy`,
are the game's own reflection names. They were first read from community Cheat
Engine tables posted on FearLess Revolution (topic 35282, tables by matthew80,
Sianz and VampTY). No code or offsets from those tables are used: the tool finds
every attribute by name at run time.

## resvg

The minimap's SVG icons are rasterised with resvg and usvg (Apache-2.0 OR MIT,
https://github.com/linebender/resvg) and tiny-skia (BSD-3-Clause,
https://github.com/linebender/tiny-skia), linked into the binary from crates.io.

## egui_taffy, taffy

- egui_taffy 0.14 — https://github.com/PPakalns/egui_taffy — MIT
- taffy 0.9 — https://github.com/DioxusLabs/taffy — MIT

The panel's Flexbox and Grid layout. Linked as crates; nothing vendored.

## serde_json

`serde_json` (MIT OR Apache-2.0) reads the survey's JSON (`src/survey.rs`) and GitHub's release
listing (`src/ui/update.rs`).

## sha2

`sha2` 0.10 (MIT OR Apache-2.0, https://github.com/RustCrypto/hashes) checks a downloaded release
against its `.sha256` (`src/ui/update.rs`). Linked as a crate.

## CUE4Parse (tools/survey)

`tools/survey` uses CUE4Parse 1.2.2 (Apache-2.0, https://github.com/FabianFG/CUE4Parse) from
NuGet to read the game's cooked assets. It is a separate tool, not linked into
`hiumod`. It decompresses with Oodle (`oo2core_9_win64.dll`), which is downloaded to
the player's own `Mods\tools` and never redistributed.

Release zip: `survey\` holds tools/survey published with its NuGet dependencies (CUE4Parse and what it
brings: Newtonsoft.Json, Serilog, K4os LZ4, ZstdSharp, Zlib-ng.NET, Oodle.NET wrapper, BouncyCastle, Blake3,
SevenZip, CommunityToolkit.HighPerformance, UE4Config, OffiUtils, CUE4Parse-Natives), each under its own
licence. Oodle itself (oo2core) is not shipped: the tool fetches it on first use.


```

`assets/i18n/help/de.txt`:

```txt
hiumod — Einzelspieler-Cheats und eine Minikarte für Hell Is Us (Steam)

VERWENDUNG
  hiumod                        startet bei Bedarf das Spiel; ` (~) zeigt/versteckt das Panel;
                                das Panel schließt sich, wenn das Spiel endet
  hiumod ui                     nur das Panel; startet das Spiel nicht
  hiumod doctor                 prüft alles; schreibt nichts
  hiumod doctor inspect <target> [depth] [gaps]
                                jedes reflektierte Feld eines laufenden Objekts, mit Name und
                                Wert; Zeiger werden `depth` Ebenen tief verfolgt (Standard 0);
                                `gaps` zeigt auch die nativen Bytes zwischen den Feldern
  hiumod doctor find <text>     jede Klassen- oder Struct-Eigenschaft, deren Name den Text enthält
  hiumod doctor dump [prefix]...
                                eine SDK-ähnliche Liste der Klassen und Structs, deren
                                Namen mit einem Präfix beginnen (Standard Charlie, Story)
  hiumod doctor usmap           die geladenen Klassen, Structs und Enums als .usmap-
                                Mappings-Datei, für tools/survey
  hiumod doctor survey [world]  Mappings, dann tools/survey über die Karten des Spiels:
                                was jede Welt hergibt, nach Mods\survey —
                                und der Spieltext in seinen 12 Sprachen
  hiumod doctor locale          nur der Spieltext, nach Mods\locale: Gegenstands-, NPC-
                                und Regionsnamen in der Spielsprache
  hiumod doctor saves [s]       alle Spielstandobjekte im Speicher, alle 5 s: Datum,
                                Fakten, erledigte Taten — welches das Spiel beim Spielen ändert
  hiumod doctor watch <target> [seconds]
                                was sich in einem Objekt ändert, benannt oder nativ, während es passiert
  hiumod doctor scan <target> <value>
  hiumod doctor scan next <value>
                                wo in einem Objekt ein Wert liegt; dann, nachdem er sich
                                im Spiel geändert hat, welche dieser Stellen sich mitgeändert haben
                                Ziele: hero, controller, asc, sets, inventory, items,
                                save, world, enemy[:N], 0xADRESSE oder ein Klassenname[:N]
                                — Ergebnisse werden auch nach Mods\doctor geschrieben
  hiumod list                   jedes Attribut jedes Sets, live gelesen
  hiumod get <attribute>...     einige davon, als Name oder Set.Name
  hiumod pose                   wo der Held steht und hinsieht, live gelesen bis Ctrl+C
  hiumod set <cheat> <value>    ein einmalig geschriebener Wert (noch keiner in der Tabelle)
  hiumod hold <cheat>...        z. B. god stamina speed=2 — bis Ctrl+C;
                                jeder haltbare Cheat steht in der Liste von `hiumod doctor`
  hiumod restore                stellt zurück, was ein beendetes hold verändert hat

OPTIONEN
  --game-dir <dir>              das Installationsverzeichnis, das HellIsUs\ enthält
                                (Standard: in deinen Steam-Bibliotheken gefunden)

Es wird nichts geschrieben, solange du den Helden nicht steuerst. Sichere deinen Spielstand.

```

`assets/i18n/help/en.txt`:

```txt
hiumod — single-player cheats and a minimap for Hell Is Us (Steam)

USAGE
  hiumod                        start the game if needed, then the panel — ` (~) shows/hides it;
                                the panel closes when the game does
  hiumod ui                     the panel only; does not start the game
  hiumod doctor                 check everything; writes nothing
  hiumod doctor inspect <target> [depth] [gaps]
                                every reflected field of a live object, by name and
                                value; pointers followed `depth` levels (default 0);
                                `gaps` also shows the native bytes between fields
  hiumod doctor find <text>     every class or struct property whose name holds text
  hiumod doctor dump [prefix]...
                                an SDK-like listing of the classes and structs whose
                                names start with a prefix (default Charlie, Story)
  hiumod doctor usmap           the loaded classes, structs and enums as a .usmap
                                mappings file, for tools/survey
  hiumod doctor survey [world]  mappings, then tools/survey over the game's maps:
                                what every world hands out, to Mods\survey —
                                and the game's text in its 12 languages
  hiumod doctor locale          only the game's text, to Mods\locale: item, NPC
                                and region names in the game's language
  hiumod doctor saves [s]       every save object in memory every 5 s: date, facts,
                                deeds done — which one the game updates as you play
  hiumod doctor watch <target> [seconds]
                                what changes in an object, named or native, as it does
  hiumod doctor scan <target> <value>
  hiumod doctor scan next <value>
                                find where a value sits in an object; then, after it
                                changes in game, which of those places changed with it
                                targets: hero, controller, asc, sets, inventory, items,
                                save, world, enemy[:N], 0xADDRESS, or a class name[:N]
                                — results are also written to Mods\doctor
  hiumod list                   every attribute of every set, read live
  hiumod get <attribute>...     some of them, as Name or Set.Name
  hiumod pose                   where the hero stands and faces, read live until Ctrl+C
  hiumod set <cheat> <value>    write a value once (none in the table yet)
  hiumod hold <cheat>...        e.g. god stamina speed=2 — until Ctrl+C;
                                every held cheat is in `hiumod doctor`'s list
  hiumod restore                restore anything a killed hold left changed

OPTIONS
  --game-dir <dir>              the install root, holding HellIsUs\
                                (default: found in your Steam libraries)

Nothing is written unless you are in control of the hero. Back up your save.

```

```txt
  hiumod set <cheat> <value>    un valore scritto una volta (ancora nessuno nella tabella)
  hiumod hold <cheat>...        es. god stamina speed=2 — fino a Ctrl+C;
                                ogni trucco mantenibile è nell'elenco di `hiumod doctor`
  hiumod restore                ripristina ciò che un hold interrotto ha lasciato modificato

                                (predefinito: cercata nelle tue librerie Steam)
```

```txt
hiumod — Hell Is Us (Steam) 用のシングルプレイ向けチートとミニマップ

                                動作中のオブジェクトの全リフレクションフィールドを名前と値で表示。

                                名前が接頭辞で始まるクラス・構造体の SDK 風一覧

                                マッピングファイルとして出力 (tools/survey 用)

  hiumod doctor locale          ゲームのテキストだけを Mods\locale に保存:
                                アイテム・NPC・エリアの名前を各言語で
  hiumod doctor saves [s]       メモリ上の全セーブオブジェクトを5秒ごとに表示: 日付・事実・
                                達成した善行 — プレイ中にゲームが更新するもの
  hiumod doctor watch <target> [seconds]
                                オブジェクト内で何が変わるかを、名前付きまたはネイティブで随時表示
  hiumod doctor scan <target> <value>
  hiumod doctor scan next <value>
                                オブジェクト内で値のある場所を探す。ゲーム内で値が変わった後、
                                その場所のうち一緒に変わったものを表示
                                対象: hero, controller, asc, sets, inventory, items,
                                save, world, enemy[:N], 0xADDRESS, またはクラス名[:N]
                                — 結果は Mods\doctor にも書き込まれる
  hiumod list                   全セットの全属性をリアルタイムで表示
  hiumod get <attribute>...     指定した属性を Name または Set.Name で表示
  hiumod pose                   主人公の位置と向きを Ctrl+C までリアルタイムで表示
  hiumod set <cheat> <value>    値を一度だけ書き込む (表にはまだなし)
  hiumod hold <cheat>...        例: god stamina speed=2 — Ctrl+C まで保持。
                                使えるチートは `hiumod doctor` の一覧に載っている

オプション
  --game-dir <dir>              HellIsUs\ を含むインストールのルート
                                (既定: Steam ライブラリから検出)
```

```txt
  hiumod doctor watch <대상> [초]
                                객체에서 바뀌는 값을 (이름 있는 필드든 네이티브든)
                                바뀔 때마다 출력
  hiumod doctor scan <대상> <값>
  hiumod doctor scan next <값>  객체에서 값이 있는 곳을 찾음; 게임에서 값을 바꾼 뒤에는
```

```txt
                                名称以指定前缀开头的类和结构体的

                                已完成的好事，可看出游戏游玩时更新的是哪一个
  hiumod doctor watch <target> [seconds]
                                实时显示对象中发生的变化，按名称或原生字节
  hiumod doctor scan <target> <value>
  hiumod doctor scan next <value>
                                查找某个值在对象中的位置；在游戏中改变该值后，
                                再显示其中哪些位置随之改变
                                目标：hero, controller, asc, sets, inventory, items,
                                save, world, enemy[:N], 0xADDRESS 或类名[:N]
                                结果同时写入 Mods\doctor
  hiumod list                   实时读取每个集合的每个属性
  hiumod get <attribute>...     读取其中一部分，以 Name 或 Set.Name 指定
  hiumod pose                   实时显示主角的位置与朝向，按 Ctrl+C 退出
  hiumod set <cheat> <value>    一次性写入的数值（表中暂无）
  hiumod hold <cheat>...        例如 god stamina speed=2，持续到按 Ctrl+C；
                                所有可保持的作弊都列在 `hiumod doctor` 中
  hiumod restore                还原被强制结束的 hold 所遗留的修改

选项
  --game-dir <dir>              安装根目录，其中包含 HellIsUs\
                                （默认：在你的 Steam 库中查找）

只有在你操控主角时才会写入。请备份存档。

```

`docs/assets/site.js`:

```js
// The hero: Hadea as a contour map. A terrain mesh drawn only as topographic lines
// (the game's own motif) in fog, with a route traced across it in Lymbic blue — the
// minimap's job, shown rather than told. Everything else on the page is static HTML.
import * as THREE from 'three';

const canvas = document.getElementById('terrain');
const still = matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

// value noise, a few octaves: hills, not spikes
function noise2(seed) {
  const p = new Uint8Array(512);
  let s = seed;
  for (let i = 0; i < 256; i++) p[i] = i;
  for (let i = 255; i > 0; i--) { s = (s * 16807) % 2147483647; const j = s % (i + 1); [p[i], p[j]] = [p[j], p[i]]; }
  for (let i = 0; i < 256; i++) p[i + 256] = p[i];
  const g = (h) => (p[h] / 255) * 2 - 1;
  const f = (t) => t * t * (3 - 2 * t);
  return (x, y) => {
    const xi = Math.floor(x) & 255, yi = Math.floor(y) & 255, xf = x - Math.floor(x), yf = y - Math.floor(y);
    const a = g(p[xi] + yi), b = g(p[xi + 1] + yi), c = g(p[xi] + yi + 1), d = g(p[xi + 1] + yi + 1);
    const u = f(xf), v = f(yf);
    return a + (b - a) * u + (c - a) * v + (a - b - c + d) * u * v;
  };
}
const n = noise2(1620730);
const height = (x, z) => {
  let h = 0, amp = 1, fr = 0.035;
  for (let o = 0; o < 5; o++) { h += n(x * fr, z * fr) * amp; amp *= 0.5; fr *= 2.1; }
  // a valley down the middle where the route runs
  const valley = Math.exp(-((x - Math.sin(z * 0.05) * 14) ** 2) / 220);
  return h * 13 - valley * 7;
};

function start() {
  let renderer;
  try {
    // MSAA only touches the full-resolution passes (the upscale, the depth fill, the
    // route), which are cheap; the terrain's contours antialias themselves (fwidth).
    renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ canvas, antialias: true, alpha: false, powerPreference: 'low-power', precision: 'mediump' });
  } catch {
    document.documentElement.classList.add('no-webgl');
    return;
  }
  // Two resolutions. The terrain — its contour shader is nearly all the cost — is
  // drawn into a buffer at about two thirds of the CSS pixels and scaled up
  // smoothly; fog and soft lines lose nothing visible. The route and the beacon,
  // thin and sharp, are drawn over it at the screen's own resolution, against the
  // terrain's depth filled in again at full size (depth only: no shading), so the
  // hills still hide them. The terrain's scale adapts (see frame) from 0.45 to 0.85.
  const FULL = Math.min(devicePixelRatio, 1.5);
  const MAX_SCALE = 0.85, MIN_SCALE = 0.45;
  let scale = 0.66;
  renderer.setPixelRatio(FULL);
  renderer.autoClear = false;
  const low = new THREE.WebGLRenderTarget(1, 1, { minFilter: THREE.LinearFilter, magFilter: THREE.LinearFilter, depthBuffer: true });
  const scene = new THREE.Scene();
  const overlay = new THREE.Scene();
  const ground = new THREE.Color('#0e1217');
  scene.background = ground;
  scene.fog = new THREE.FogExp2(ground, 0.0105);
  const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(48, 1, 1, 230); // past ~200 m it is all fog

  // the terrain: contour lines in the fragment shader, every 1.6 m, every fifth heavier
  const size = 260, seg = 160; // ~51k triangles: fewer and the contour lines kink at the quads
  const geo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(size, size, seg, seg);
  geo.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2);
  const pos = geo.attributes.position;
  for (let i = 0; i < pos.count; i++) pos.setY(i, height(pos.getX(i), pos.getZ(i)));
  geo.computeVertexNormals();
  const uniforms = {
    uTime: { value: 0 },
    uFog: { value: ground },
    uLine: { value: new THREE.Color('#8b96a3') },
    uAccent: { value: new THREE.Color('#5a9ce6') },
    uFocus: { value: new THREE.Vector2(0, 0) },
    uFogDensity: { value: 0.0105 },
  };
  const mat = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
    uniforms,
    extensions: { derivatives: true },
    vertexShader: /* glsl */ `
      varying float vH; varying vec3 vW; varying float vDepth; varying vec3 vN;
      void main() {
        vec4 w = modelMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
        vW = w.xyz; vH = position.y; vN = normal;
        vec4 mv = viewMatrix * w; vDepth = -mv.z;
        gl_Position = projectionMatrix * mv;
      }`,
    fragmentShader: /* glsl */ `
      uniform float uTime; uniform vec3 uFog; uniform vec3 uLine; uniform vec3 uAccent;
      uniform vec2 uFocus; uniform float uFogDensity;
      varying float vH; varying vec3 vW; varying float vDepth; varying vec3 vN;
      float contour(float v, float step, float width) {
        float f = abs(fract(v / step - 0.5) - 0.5) / fwidth(v / step);
        return 1.0 - clamp(f / width, 0.0, 1.0);
      }
      void main() {
        float minor = contour(vH, 1.6, 1.0);
        float major = contour(vH, 8.0, 1.4);
        float shade = 0.5 + 0.5 * dot(normalize(vN), normalize(vec3(-0.5, 0.8, 0.3)));
        vec3 base = mix(uFog, vec3(0.085, 0.105, 0.13), shade * 0.9);
        vec3 col = base + uLine * (minor * 0.22 + major * 0.55);
        // a slow sweep of light rippling out from the focus point
        float d = length(vW.xz - uFocus);
        float ring = smoothstep(2.5, 0.0, abs(d - mod(uTime * 9.0, 140.0))) * smoothstep(140.0, 30.0, d);
        col += uAccent * ring * (minor + major) * 0.9;
        float fog = 1.0 - exp(-uFogDensity * uFogDensity * vDepth * vDepth);
        gl_FragColor = vec4(mix(col, uFog, clamp(fog, 0.0, 1.0)), 1.0);
      }`,
  });
  scene.add(new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat));
  const depthOnly = new THREE.Mesh(geo, new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ colorWrite: false }));
  depthOnly.renderOrder = -1;
  overlay.add(depthOnly);

  // the low-resolution terrain, stretched over the screen
  const flat = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-1, 1, 1, -1, 0, 1);
  const upscale = new THREE.Scene();
  upscale.add(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(2, 2), new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
    uniforms: { uLow: { value: low.texture } },
    depthTest: false,
    depthWrite: false,
    vertexShader: `varying vec2 vUv; void main(){ vUv = uv; gl_Position = vec4(position.xy, 0.0, 1.0); }`,
    fragmentShader: `uniform sampler2D uLow; varying vec2 vUv; void main(){ gl_FragColor = texture2D(uLow, vUv); }`,
  })));

  // the route: along the valley floor, a little above it
  const pts = [];
  for (let z = 90; z >= -60; z -= 2) {
    const x = Math.sin(z * 0.05) * 14 + Math.sin(z * 0.17) * 2.5;
    pts.push(new THREE.Vector3(x, height(x, z) + 0.6, z));
  }
  const curve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(pts);
  const tube = new THREE.TubeGeometry(curve, 220, 0.22, 4, false);
  const routeMat = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
    uniforms: { uTime: uniforms.uTime, uAccent: uniforms.uAccent },
    transparent: true,
    depthWrite: false,
    blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending,
    vertexShader: `varying vec2 vUv; void main(){ vUv = uv; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); }`,
    fragmentShader: /* glsl */ `
      uniform float uTime; uniform vec3 uAccent; varying vec2 vUv;
      void main() {
        float grow = smoothstep(0.0, 1.0, clamp(uTime * 0.18, 0.0, 1.0));
        if (vUv.x > grow) discard;
        float dash = step(0.45, fract(vUv.x * 90.0 - uTime * 1.2));
        float tip = smoothstep(grow - 0.04, grow, vUv.x);
        gl_FragColor = vec4(uAccent * (0.55 + 0.45 * dash) + tip * 0.6, 0.85);
      }`,
  });
  overlay.add(new THREE.Mesh(tube, routeMat));

  // the goal: a beacon at the route's end
  const end = curve.getPoint(1);
  const beacon = new THREE.Mesh(
    new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.05, 0.6, 14, 16, 1, true),
    new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: '#5a9ce6', transparent: true, opacity: 0.25, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, depthWrite: false, side: THREE.DoubleSide }),
  );
  beacon.position.set(end.x, end.y + 7, end.z);
  overlay.add(beacon);
  uniforms.uFocus.value.set(end.x, end.z);

  // camera: a slow drift down the valley, eased toward the pointer
  const pointer = { x: 0, y: 0, tx: 0, ty: 0 };
  addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
    pointer.tx = (e.clientX / innerWidth) * 2 - 1;
    pointer.ty = (e.clientY / innerHeight) * 2 - 1;
  }, { passive: true });
  let scroll = 0;
  addEventListener('scroll', () => { scroll = Math.min(scrollY / innerHeight, 1); }, { passive: true });

  function resize() {
    const w = canvas.clientWidth, h = canvas.clientHeight;
    renderer.setSize(w, h, false);
    low.setSize(Math.max(1, Math.round(w * scale)), Math.max(1, Math.round(h * scale)));
    camera.aspect = w / h;
    camera.fov = w < 700 ? 62 : 48;
    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
  }
  new ResizeObserver(resize).observe(canvas);
  resize();

  let visible = true;
  new IntersectionObserver(([e]) => { visible = e.isIntersecting; }).observe(canvas);

  const clock = new THREE.Clock();
  const look = new THREE.Vector3();
  function frame() {
    const t = still ? 6 : clock.getElapsedTime();
    uniforms.uTime.value = t;
    pointer.x += (pointer.tx - pointer.x) * 0.04;
    pointer.y += (pointer.ty - pointer.y) * 0.04;
    const z = 95 - (t * 1.4) % 60;
    camera.position.set(Math.sin(t * 0.05) * 10 + pointer.x * 6, 26 - pointer.y * 3 + scroll * 18, z);
    look.set(Math.sin((z - 40) * 0.05) * 10, 0, z - 48);
    camera.lookAt(look);
    beacon.material.opacity = 0.18 + 0.1 * Math.sin(t * 2.0);
    renderer.setRenderTarget(low);
    renderer.clear();
    renderer.render(scene, camera);
    renderer.setRenderTarget(null);
    renderer.clear();
    renderer.render(upscale, flat);
    renderer.render(overlay, camera);
  }
  if (still) {
    frame();
    new ResizeObserver(frame).observe(canvas);
  } else {
    // 30 fps is plenty for a slow drift, and half the work of 60. The interval
    // between drawn frames also measures the GPU: a run of slow ones lowers the
    // resolution, a run of quick ones raises it back.
    const STEP = 1000 / 30;
    let last = 0, slow = 0, quick = 0;
    renderer.setAnimationLoop((now) => {
      if (!visible || document.hidden || now - last < STEP - 2) return;
      const dt = last ? now - last : STEP;
      last = now;
      frame();
      if (dt > STEP * 1.5) { slow++; quick = 0; } else if (dt < STEP * 1.1) { quick++; slow = 0; }
      if (slow > 20 && scale > MIN_SCALE) { scale = Math.max(MIN_SCALE, scale - 0.15); resize(); slow = 0; }
      if (quick > 240 && scale < MAX_SCALE) { scale = Math.min(MAX_SCALE, scale + 0.1); resize(); quick = 0; }
    });
  }
  document.documentElement.classList.add('webgl');
}

// the hero's compass strip drifts with the pointer: the HUD the game doesn't have
const track = document.querySelector('.compass-track');
if (track && !still) {
  addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
    track.style.setProperty('--turn', `${((e.clientX / innerWidth) - 0.5) * -120}px`);
  }, { passive: true });
}

// the spoiler demo
for (const v of document.querySelectorAll('.vault')) {
  const b = v.querySelector('.reveal');
  b.addEventListener('click', () => {
    const hidden = v.dataset.hidden === 'true';
    v.dataset.hidden = hidden ? 'false' : 'true';
    b.textContent = hidden ? b.dataset.hide : b.dataset.show;
    b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(hidden));
  });
}

// the film plays while it is on screen (it is muted); with reduced motion it waits
// for the player's own controls
for (const v of document.querySelectorAll('.film video')) {
  if (still) { v.controls = true; v.preload = 'metadata'; continue; }
  new IntersectionObserver(([e]) => { if (e.isIntersecting) v.play().catch(() => { v.controls = true; }); else v.pause(); },
    { threshold: 0.35 }).observe(v);
}

// sections fade up once as they arrive
const io = new IntersectionObserver((es) => {
  for (const e of es) if (e.isIntersecting) { e.target.classList.add('in'); io.unobserve(e.target); }
}, { rootMargin: '0px 0px -10% 0px' });
for (const s of document.querySelectorAll('main > section:not(.hero)')) io.observe(s);

// the language menu closes on outside click
const langs = document.querySelector('.langs');
document.addEventListener('click', (e) => { if (langs && !langs.contains(e.target)) langs.open = false; });

// Start after the page has painted and the browser is idle, so the 3D scene never
// delays the text; a phone that asks to save data gets the CSS contours instead.
const saveData = navigator.connection && navigator.connection.saveData;
if (!saveData) {
  const go = () => start();
  if ('requestIdleCallback' in window) requestIdleCallback(go, { timeout: 1500 });
  else setTimeout(go, 200);
}
```

```svg
<!-- Vault symbol 7: terror — drawn for the mod after the game's dials. 100×100, y down. -->
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
<g stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" fill="none">
<rect x="27" y="4" width="46" height="78" fill="none"/>
```

```html
  <section class="intro" aria-labelledby="intro-title">
    <h2 id="intro-title">Gemacht für die Art, wie Hell Is Us gespielt wird</h2>
    <p>Hell Is Us verzichtet auf Minikarte, Questmarker und Händchenhalten, und genau darum geht es: Deine Notizen und dein Gedächtnis führen dich. Meistens funktioniert das. Dann legst du das Spiel zwei Wochen weg, kommst zurück und weißt nicht mehr, wo die Zeitschleife war oder wessen Sohn du eigentlich finden solltest.</p>
    <p>hiumod läuft neben dem Spiel in einem eigenen Fenster. Es liest, was das Spiel ohnehin weiß – wo du bist, was du gefunden hast, welche Ermittlungen offen sind – und zeigt nur das, wonach du fragst. Schließt du es, ist das Spiel genau so, wie Rogue Factor es gemacht hat.</p>
  </section>

  <section id="features" class="features" aria-labelledby="features-title">
    <h2 id="features-title">Was es kann</h2>
    <div class="grid">
      <article><img class="ico" src="../assets/icons/interact_door.svg" alt="" width="36" height="36" loading="lazy"><h3>Minikarte in Echtzeit</h3><p>Ein Overlay, das dir durch Hadea folgt: Türen, Leitern, Händler, Verstecke und deine eigenen Kartenpins, dazu eine Route über begehbaren Boden bis zu dem Punkt, den du wählst.</p></article>
      <article><img class="ico" src="../assets/pins/quest.svg" alt="" width="36" height="36" loading="lazy"><h3>Ein Story-Guide</h3><p>Die Hauptgeschichte Schritt für Schritt, in den Worten des Spiels: wohin als Nächstes und was du mitnehmen musst. Jeder Schritt wird einzeln aufgedeckt, damit dir nichts vorab gespoilert wird.</p></article>
      <article><img class="ico" src="../assets/icons/item_quest.svg" alt="" width="36" height="36" loading="lazy"><h3>Ein Quest-Tracker</h3><p>Jede offene Ermittlung aus deiner Datenbank, aktualisiert während du spielst, mit den Personen, Orten und Gegenständen, die darin vorkommen – und mit denen, die du vor einem Punkt ohne Wiederkehr noch verpassen kannst.</p></article>
      <article><img class="ico" src="../assets/icons/interact_puzzle.svg" alt="" width="36" height="36" loading="lazy"><h3>Grüfte und Rätsel</h3><p>Jedes Drehrad, jedes Tastenfeld und jede Gegenstandsplatzierung im Spiel, dazu die Codes der sechs Grüfte des Verbotenen Wissens, gezeichnet mit den Symbolen des Spiels. Jede Antwort bleibt verdeckt, bis du sie anklickst.</p></article>
      <article><img class="ico" src="../assets/icons/enemy_group.svg" alt="" width="36" height="36" loading="lazy"><h3>Sammelobjekte und Gegner</h3><p>Sammelobjekte nach Region, die Gegnergruppen, die dir für den Erfolg „jeder Hollow“ noch fehlen, NPCs, die mehr zu erzählen haben, und deine Steam-Erfolge mit Fortschritt.</p></article>
      <article><img class="ico" src="../assets/icons/npc.svg" alt="" width="36" height="36" loading="lazy"><h3>Deine Sprache</h3><p>Alles folgt der im Spiel eingestellten Sprache, in allen zwölf, die es mitbringt, und mit den Namen, die das Spiel selbst für Orte, Personen und Dinge verwendet.</p></article>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section id="spoilers" class="spoilers" aria-labelledby="spoilers-title">
    <div class="spoilers-copy">
      <h2 id="spoilers-title">Spoiler nur auf Nachfrage</h2>
      <p>Jede Antwort ist zunächst verdeckt. Öffne die Gruft, vor der du stehst, und sonst nichts – der Rest der Liste bleibt so unbekannt wie zuvor. Das Beispiel rechts ist ein erfundener Code.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="vault" data-hidden="true">
      <p class="vault-name">Beispiel-Gruft</p>
      <div class="vault-code" aria-label="Beispielcode, vier Symbole">
        <img src="../assets/symbols/terror.svg" alt="Terror">
        <img src="../assets/symbols/admiration.svg" alt="Bewunderung">
        <img src="../assets/symbols/rage.svg" alt="Wut">
        <img src="../assets/symbols/amazement.svg" alt="Begeisterung">
      </div>
      <button class="btn reveal" type="button" data-show="Code aufdecken" data-hide="Wieder verdecken">Code aufdecken</button>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="safety" aria-labelledby="safety-title">
    <h2 id="safety-title">Was es nicht tut</h2>
    <ul>
      <li><strong>Es fasst deine Dateien nicht an.</strong> Weder im Spielordner noch an deinen Spielständen wird etwas verändert; es liest den Speicher von außen.</li>
      <li><strong>Es ist nicht online.</strong> Hell Is Us ist ein Einzelspielerspiel, und hiumod sendet nichts irgendwohin.</li>
      <li><strong>Cheats sind optional.</strong> Gesundheit, Ausdauer, Tempo und ein paar mehr sind dabei – alle aus, bis du sie einschaltest, nur wirksam, solange du den Helden steuerst, und zurückgesetzt, sobald du sie ausschaltest.</li>
      <li><strong>Es prüft die Spielversion.</strong> Nach einem Spielupdate sagt es dir das, statt zu raten – bis es erneut getestet wurde.</li>
    </ul>
  </section>

  <section id="install" class="install" aria-labelledby="install-title">
    <h2 id="install-title">Installation in drei Schritten</h2>
    <ol>
      <li><h3>Herunterladen</h3><p>Lade das neueste Zip von der Releases-Seite und entpacke es, wo du willst. Geschrieben wird nur in den Ordner Mods im Spielverzeichnis.</p></li>
      <li><h3>hiumod.exe doppelklicken</h3><p>Läuft das Spiel noch nicht, startet es hiumod über Steam und verbindet sich, sobald du im Spiel bist. Mit ` (die Taste links neben der 1) blendest du das Panel ein und aus. Shift+` öffnet eine Konsole zum Prüfen.</p></li>
      <li><h3>Die Spieldaten liest es selbst</h3><p>Sobald du den Helden zum ersten Mal steuerst, liest hiumod die Karten und Texte des Spiels von selbst in den Mods-Ordner (etwa zwei Minuten). Fehlt die .NET-8-Laufzeit, bietet das Panel an, sie zu installieren.</p></li>
    </ol>
    <a class="btn btn-main" href="https://github.com/myso-kr/hell-is-us-mod/releases/latest">Für Windows herunterladen</a>
  </section>

  <section id="faq" class="faq" aria-labelledby="faq-title">
    <h2 id="faq-title">Fragen</h2>
    <details><summary>Gibt es in Hell Is Us eine Karte?</summary><p>Nein. Hell Is Us verzichtet bewusst auf Karte, Kompass und Questmarker. hiumod ergänzt am PC eine optionale Minikarte als Overlay und einen Quest-Tracker für alle, die so etwas möchten.</p></details>
    <details><summary>Wo finde ich die Codes für die Grüfte in Hell Is Us?</summary><p>Die Codes sind als Notizen und Inschriften über ganz Hadea verteilt. hiumod listet den Code jeder Gruft mit den Symbolen des Spiels auf, jeweils verdeckt, bis du ihn aufdeckst.</p></details>
    <details><summary>Kann man für hiumod gebannt werden?</summary><p>Hell Is Us ist ein reines Einzelspielerspiel ohne Anti-Cheat und ohne Online-Modus, und hiumod verändert keine Spieldateien. Wie bei jedem Drittanbieter-Tool gilt: Die Nutzung liegt in deinem Ermessen.</p></details>
    <details><summary>Funktioniert hiumod mit der aktuellen Spielversion?</summary><p>hiumod wird gegen einen bestimmten Steam-Build getestet und sagt dir, wenn das Spiel seitdem aktualisiert wurde. Nach einem Update liest es die Spieldaten von selbst neu ein; was dabei kaputtgeht, wird in einer neuen Version behoben.</p></details>
    <details><summary>Welche Sprachen werden unterstützt?</summary><p>Alle zwölf Sprachen des Spiels: Englisch, Koreanisch, Japanisch, vereinfachtes Chinesisch, Deutsch, Französisch, Spanisch, Italienisch, Polnisch, brasilianisches Portugiesisch, Russisch und Türkisch. Es richtet sich nach der im Spiel eingestellten Sprache.</p></details>
    <details><summary>Ist hiumod kostenlos?</summary><p>Ja. Es ist kostenlos und Open Source unter der MIT-Lizenz. Es ist ein Fanprojekt ohne Verbindung zu Rogue Factor oder Nacon.</p></details>
  </section>
</main>
```

```html
  <section class="intro" aria-labelledby="intro-title">
    <h2 id="intro-title">Pensado para cómo se juega a Hell Is Us</h2>
    <p>Hell Is Us te quita el minimapa, los marcadores de misión y la mano que te guía, y esa es la gracia: tus notas y tu memoria marcan el camino. Casi siempre funciona. Hasta que dejas el juego dos semanas, vuelves y ya no recuerdas dónde estaba aquel bucle temporal ni de quién era el hijo que tenías que encontrar.</p>
    <p>hiumod se ejecuta junto al juego, en su propia ventana. Lee lo que el juego ya sabe (dónde estás, qué has encontrado, qué misiones tienes abiertas) y solo te muestra lo que le pides. Ciérralo y el juego queda exactamente como lo hizo Rogue Factor.</p>
  </section>

  <section id="features" class="features" aria-labelledby="features-title">
    <h2 id="features-title">Qué hace</h2>
    <div class="grid">
      <article><img class="ico" src="../assets/icons/interact_door.svg" alt="" width="36" height="36" loading="lazy"><h3>Un minimapa en tiempo real</h3><p>Una capa superpuesta que te acompaña por Hadea: puertas, escaleras, comerciantes, alijos y los marcadores que tú mismo colocas, con una ruta trazada por el terreno transitable hasta donde señales.</p></article>
      <article><img class="ico" src="../assets/pins/quest.svg" alt="" width="36" height="36" loading="lazy"><h3>Una guía de la historia</h3><p>La historia principal paso a paso, con las propias palabras del juego: adónde ir y qué llevar, revelado de paso en paso para que nada de lo que viene se destripe solo.</p></article>
      <article><img class="ico" src="../assets/icons/item_quest.svg" alt="" width="36" height="36" loading="lazy"><h3>Un rastreador de misiones</h3><p>Todas las misiones abiertas de tu diario, actualizadas mientras juegas, con las personas, lugares y objetos que mencionan, y las que aún puedes perder antes de un punto sin retorno.</p></article>
      <article><img class="ico" src="../assets/icons/interact_puzzle.svg" alt="" width="36" height="36" loading="lazy"><h3>Cámaras y puzles</h3><p>Todos los diales, teclados y colocaciones de objetos del juego, y los códigos de las seis cámaras de conocimiento prohibido dibujados con los símbolos del juego. Cada respuesta queda tapada hasta que haces clic en ella.</p></article>
      <article><img class="ico" src="../assets/icons/enemy_group.svg" alt="" width="36" height="36" loading="lazy"><h3>Coleccionables y enemigos</h3><p>Coleccionables por región, los grupos de enemigos que te faltan para el logro de todos los Hollow, PNJ con algo más que contar y tus logros de Steam con su progreso.</p></article>
      <article><img class="ico" src="../assets/icons/npc.svg" alt="" width="36" height="36" loading="lazy"><h3>Tu idioma</h3><p>Todo sigue el idioma configurado en el juego, en los doce que incluye, con los mismos nombres que usa el juego para lugares, personas y objetos.</p></article>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section id="spoilers" class="spoilers" aria-labelledby="spoilers-title">
    <div class="spoilers-copy">
      <h2 id="spoilers-title">Spoilers solo cuando los pides</h2>
      <p>Todas las respuestas empiezan ocultas. Abre la cámara que tienes delante y nada más; el resto de la lista sigue tan desconocido como antes. El ejemplo de la derecha es un código inventado.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="vault" data-hidden="true">
      <p class="vault-name">Cámara de ejemplo</p>

        <img src="../assets/symbols/terror.svg" alt="Terror">
        <img src="../assets/symbols/admiration.svg" alt="Admiración">

        <img src="../assets/symbols/amazement.svg" alt="Asombro">
      </div>

  <section class="safety" aria-labelledby="safety-title">
    <h2 id="safety-title">Lo que no hace</h2>
    <ul>
      <li><strong>No toca tus archivos.</strong> No modifica nada en la carpeta del juego ni en tus partidas guardadas; lee la memoria desde fuera.</li>
      <li><strong>No se conecta a internet.</strong> Hell Is Us es un juego para un jugador y hiumod no envía nada a ningún sitio.</li>
      <li><strong>Los trucos son opcionales.</strong> Salud, aguante, velocidad y algunos más: todos desactivados hasta que los activas, solo se aplican mientras controlas al protagonista y se restauran al desactivarlos.</li>
      <li><strong>Comprueba la versión del juego.</strong> Tras una actualización del juego te lo indica en lugar de suponer nada, hasta que se haya vuelto a probar.</li>
    </ul>
  </section>

  <section id="install" class="install" aria-labelledby="install-title">
    <h2 id="install-title">Instalación en tres pasos</h2>
    <ol>
      <li><h3>Descarga</h3><p>Descarga el último zip desde la página de Releases y descomprímelo donde quieras. Solo escribe en la carpeta Mods del directorio del juego.</p></li>
      <li><h3>Haz doble clic en hiumod.exe</h3><p>Si el juego no está abierto, lo inicia a través de Steam y se engancha en cuanto entras. Pulsa ` (la tecla a la izquierda del 1) para mostrar u ocultar el panel. Shift+` abre una consola para comprobar cosas.</p></li>
      <li><h3>Lee el juego una vez, por su cuenta</h3><p>La primera vez que controlas al protagonista, hiumod lee por su cuenta los mapas y textos del juego en la carpeta Mods (unos dos minutos). Si falta el runtime de .NET 8, el panel ofrece instalarlo.</p></li>
    </ol>
    <a class="btn btn-main" href="https://github.com/myso-kr/hell-is-us-mod/releases/latest">Descargar para Windows</a>
  </section>

  <section id="faq" class="faq" aria-labelledby="faq-title">
    <h2 id="faq-title">Preguntas</h2>
    <details><summary>¿Hell Is Us tiene mapa?</summary><p>No. Hell Is Us no tiene mapa, brújula ni marcadores de misión de forma intencionada. hiumod añade en PC un minimapa superpuesto y un rastreador de misiones opcionales para quien los quiera.</p></details>
    <details><summary>¿Dónde están los códigos de las cámaras en Hell Is Us?</summary><p>Los códigos están repartidos por Hadea en notas e inscripciones. hiumod muestra el código de cada cámara con los símbolos del juego, cada uno oculto hasta que decides revelarlo.</p></details>
    <details><summary>¿Me pueden banear por usar hiumod?</summary><p>Hell Is Us es un juego para un jugador, sin antitrampas ni modo en línea, y hiumod no modifica ningún archivo del juego. Como con cualquier herramienta de terceros, úsala bajo tu propio criterio.</p></details>
    <details><summary>¿Funciona con la última versión del juego?</summary><p>hiumod se prueba con una build concreta de Steam y te avisa cuando el juego se ha actualizado desde entonces. Tras una actualización vuelve a leer los datos del juego por su cuenta; lo que se rompa se corrige en una nueva versión.</p></details>
    <details><summary>¿En qué idiomas está?</summary><p>En los doce idiomas del juego: inglés, coreano, japonés, chino simplificado, alemán, francés, español, italiano, polaco, portugués de Brasil, ruso y turco. Usa el idioma configurado en el juego.</p></details>
    <details><summary>¿hiumod es gratis?</summary><p>Sí. Es gratuito y de código abierto con licencia MIT. Es un proyecto de fans sin relación con Rogue Factor ni con Nacon.</p></details>
  </section>
</main>
```

```html
  <section class="intro" aria-labelledby="intro-title">
    <h2 id="intro-title">Pensé pour la façon dont on joue à Hell Is Us</h2>
    <p>Hell Is Us retire la minicarte, les marqueurs de quête et l’assistance, et c’est voulu  vos notes et votre mémoire servent de guide. La plupart du temps, ça fonctionne. Puis vous lâchez le jeu deux semaines, vous revenez, et vous ne savez plus où était la boucle temporelle ni de qui vous deviez retrouver le fils.</p>
    <p>hiumod tourne à côté du jeu, dans sa propre fenêtre. Il lit ce que le jeu sait déjà — où vous êtes, ce que vous avez trouvé, quelles quêtes sont en cours — et n’affiche que ce que vous demandez. Fermez-le, et le jeu redevient exactement celui de Rogue Factor.</p>
  </section>

  <section id="features" class="features" aria-labelledby="features-title">
    <h2 id="features-title">Ce qu’il fait</h2>
    <div class="grid">
      <article><img class="ico" src="../assets/icons/interact_door.svg" alt="" width="36" height="36" loading="lazy"><h3>Une minicarte en direct</h3><p>Une surcouche qui vous suit dans Hadéa  portes, échelles, marchands, cachettes et les repères que vous placez vous-même, avec un itinéraire tracé sur le terrain praticable jusqu’au point que vous désignez.</p></article>
      <article><img class="ico" src="../assets/pins/quest.svg" alt="" width="36" height="36" loading="lazy"><h3>Un guide de l’histoire</h3><p>La quête principale étape par étape, avec les mots du jeu  où aller ensuite et quoi emporter, révélé une étape à la fois, pour que rien de ce qui vous attend ne se gâche tout seul.</p></article>
      <article><img class="ico" src="../assets/icons/item_quest.svg" alt="" width="36" height="36" loading="lazy"><h3>Un suivi de quêtes</h3><p>Chaque quête en cours de votre journal, mise à jour pendant que vous jouez, avec les personnes, lieux et objets qu’elle mentionne — et celles que vous pouvez encore manquer avant un point de non-retour.</p></article>
      <article><img class="ico" src="../assets/icons/interact_puzzle.svg" alt="" width="36" height="36" loading="lazy"><h3>Chambres et énigmes</h3><p>Chaque cadran, digicode et emplacement d’objet du jeu, et les codes des six chambres des savoirs interdits, dessinés avec les symboles du jeu. Chaque réponse reste masquée jusqu’à ce que vous cliquiez dessus.</p></article>
      <article><img class="ico" src="../assets/icons/enemy_group.svg" alt="" width="36" height="36" loading="lazy"><h3>Objets à collectionner et ennemis</h3><p>Les objets à collectionner par région, les groupes d’ennemis restants pour le succès qui demande d’éliminer tous les Hollow, les PNJ qui ont encore des choses à dire, et vos succès Steam avec leur progression.</p></article>
      <article><img class="ico" src="../assets/icons/npc.svg" alt="" width="36" height="36" loading="lazy"><h3>Votre langue</h3><p>Tout suit la langue choisie dans le jeu, parmi les douze qu’il propose, avec les noms que le jeu donne lui-même aux lieux, aux personnes et aux choses.</p></article>
    </div>
  </section>

      <p>Chaque réponse commence masquée. Ouvrez la chambre devant laquelle vous vous trouvez, et rien d’autre  le reste de la liste demeure aussi inconnu qu’avant. L’exemple à droite est un code inventé.</p>

  <section class="safety" aria-labelledby="safety-title">
    <h2 id="safety-title">Ce qu’il ne fait pas</h2>
    <ul>
      <li><strong>Il ne touche pas à vos fichiers.</strong> Rien n’est modifié dans le dossier du jeu ni dans vos sauvegardes  il lit la mémoire depuis l’extérieur.</li>
      <li><strong>Il ne se connecte à rien.</strong> Hell Is Us est un jeu solo, et hiumod n’envoie rien nulle part.</li>
      <li><strong>Les triches sont facultatives.</strong> Santé, endurance, vitesse et quelques autres sont disponibles, toutes désactivées tant que vous ne les activez pas, appliquées uniquement quand vous contrôlez le héros, et rétablies dès que vous les coupez.</li>
      <li><strong>Il vérifie la version du jeu.</strong> Après une mise à jour du jeu, il vous le signale au lieu de deviner, jusqu’à ce qu’il ait été testé de nouveau.</li>
    </ul>
  </section>

  <section id="install" class="install" aria-labelledby="install-title">
    <h2 id="install-title">Installation en trois étapes</h2>
    <ol>
      <li><h3>Télécharger</h3><p>Récupérez le dernier zip sur la page Releases et décompressez-le où vous voulez. Il n’écrit jamais ailleurs que dans le dossier Mods du répertoire du jeu.</p></li>
      <li><h3>Double-cliquer sur hiumod.exe</h3><p>Il lance le jeu via Steam s’il n’est pas déjà ouvert et s’y connecte une fois en partie. Appuyez sur ` (la touche à gauche de 1) pour afficher ou masquer le panneau. Shift+` ouvre une console pour vérifier.</p></li>
      <li><h3>Il lit le jeu une fois, tout seul</h3><p>La première fois que vous contrôlez le héros, hiumod lit de lui-même les cartes et les textes du jeu dans le dossier Mods (environ deux minutes). Si le runtime .NET 8 manque, le panneau propose de l’installer.</p></li>
    </ol>
    <a class="btn btn-main" href="https://github.com/myso-kr/hell-is-us-mod/releases/latest">Télécharger pour Windows</a>

  <section id="faq" class="faq" aria-labelledby="faq-title">
    <h2 id="faq-title">Questions</h2>
    <details><summary>Y a-t-il une carte dans Hell Is Us </summary><p>Non. Hell Is Us n’a volontairement ni carte, ni boussole, ni marqueurs de quête. Sur PC, hiumod ajoute en option une minicarte en surcouche et un suivi de quêtes pour les joueurs qui en veulent.</p></details>
    <details><summary>Où trouver les codes des chambres des savoirs interdits dans Hell Is Us </summary><p>Les codes sont disséminés dans Hadéa, sous forme de notes et d’inscriptions. hiumod donne le code de chaque chambre avec les symboles du jeu, chacun masqué jusqu’à ce que vous choisissiez de le révéler.</p></details>
    <details><summary>Peut-on se faire bannir en utilisant hiumod </summary><p>Hell Is Us est un jeu solo, sans anti-triche ni mode en ligne, et hiumod ne modifie aucun fichier du jeu. Comme pour tout outil tiers, vous l’utilisez sous votre propre responsabilité.</p></details>
    <details><summary>hiumod fonctionne-t-il avec la dernière version du jeu </summary><p>hiumod est testé sur une build Steam précise et vous prévient quand le jeu a été mis à jour depuis. Après une mise à jour, il relit de lui-même les données du jeu ; ce qui casse est corrigé dans une nouvelle version.</p></details>
    <details><summary>Quelles langues sont prises en charge </summary><p>Les douze langues du jeu  anglais, coréen, japonais, chinois simplifié, allemand, français, espagnol, italien, polonais, portugais du Brésil, russe et turc. Il suit la langue choisie dans le jeu.</p></details>
    <details><summary>hiumod est-il gratuit </summary><p>Oui. Il est gratuit et open source, sous licence MIT. C’est un projet de fan, sans lien avec Rogue Factor ni Nacon.</p></details>
  </section>
</main>

  <p>hiumod est un projet de fan non officiel. Hell Is Us est une marque de ses propriétaires  ce site n’utilise aucune image ni ressource du jeu. Les icônes et symboles ont été dessinés pour le mod.</p>
```

```html
    <div class="hero-copy">
      <p class="kicker">A companion for Hell Is Us · PC</p>
      <h1 id="hero-title">No map. No compass. Unless you want one.</h1>
      <p class="lede">Hadea was built to get you lost. hiumod is there for the night you&#x27;d rather not be: a live minimap, a quest tracker that follows the story, and answers to the vaults — each one hidden until you open it.</p>
      <div class="cta">
        <a class="btn btn-main" href="https://github.com/myso-kr/hell-is-us-mod/releases/latest">Download for Windows</a>
        <a class="btn" href="#features">What it does</a>
      </div>
      <p class="fine">Free and open source · Windows 10/11 · Steam version · Not affiliated with Rogue Factor or Nacon</p>
    </div>
    <p class="scroll-hint" aria-hidden="true">Scroll</p>
  </section>

  <section class="film" aria-labelledby="film-title">
    <h2 id="film-title" class="film-title">See it in 30 seconds</h2>
    <figure>
      <video muted loop playsinline preload="none" poster="assets/media/poster.jpg" width="1920" height="1080" aria-label="hiumod introduction video: the world becomes a minimap, a quest tracker, a vault answer revealed, twelve languages">
        <source src="assets/media/hiumod-intro.webm" type="video/webm">
        <source src="assets/media/hiumod-intro.mp4" type="video/mp4">
      </video>
      <figcaption>The world turns into the map, the tracker follows the story, and a vault answer stays hidden until asked. Silent, 31 s.</figcaption>
    </figure>
  </section>

  <section class="intro" aria-labelledby="intro-title">
    <h2 id="intro-title">Built for the way Hell Is Us is played</h2>
    <p>Hell Is Us takes away the minimap, the quest markers and the hand-holding, and that&#x27;s the point: your notes and your memory do the guiding. Most of the time it works. Then you put the game down for two weeks, come back, and don&#x27;t know where the Timeloop was or whose son you were meant to find.</p>
    <p>hiumod runs beside the game as its own window. It reads what the game already knows — where you are, what you&#x27;ve found, which quests are open — and shows only what you ask it to. Close it and the game is exactly as Rogue Factor made it.</p>
  </section>

  <section id="features" class="features" aria-labelledby="features-title">
    <h2 id="features-title">What it does</h2>
    <div class="grid">
      <article><img class="ico" src="assets/icons/interact_door.svg" alt="" width="36" height="36" loading="lazy"><h3>A live minimap</h3><p>An overlay that follows you through Hadea: doors, ladders, merchants, stashes and the pins you place yourself, with a route drawn along the walkable ground to wherever you point.</p></article>
      <article><img class="ico" src="assets/pins/quest.svg" alt="" width="36" height="36" loading="lazy"><h3>A story guide</h3><p>The main story step by step, in the game&#x27;s own words: where to go next and what to bring, revealed one step at a time, so nothing ahead spoils itself.</p></article>
      <article><img class="ico" src="assets/icons/item_quest.svg" alt="" width="36" height="36" loading="lazy"><h3>A quest tracker</h3><p>Every open quest in your journal, updated as you play, with the people, places and items it mentions — and the ones you can still miss before a point of no return.</p></article>
      <article><img class="ico" src="assets/icons/interact_puzzle.svg" alt="" width="36" height="36" loading="lazy"><h3>Vaults and puzzles</h3><p>Every dial, keypad and item placement in the game, and the codes of the six Vaults of Forbidden Knowledge drawn as the game&#x27;s symbols. Each answer stays covered until you click it.</p></article>
      <article><img class="ico" src="assets/icons/enemy_group.svg" alt="" width="36" height="36" loading="lazy"><h3>Collectibles and enemies</h3><p>Collectibles by region, the enemy groups still left for the every-Hollow achievement, NPCs with more to tell, and your Steam achievements with progress.</p></article>
      <article><img class="ico" src="assets/icons/npc.svg" alt="" width="36" height="36" loading="lazy"><h3>Your language</h3><p>Everything follows the language set in the game, in all twelve it ships with, using the game&#x27;s own names for places, people and things.</p></article>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section id="spoilers" class="spoilers" aria-labelledby="spoilers-title">
    <div class="spoilers-copy">
      <h2 id="spoilers-title">Spoilers only when you ask</h2>
      <p>Every answer starts hidden. Open the vault you&#x27;re standing at and nothing else; the rest of the list stays as unknown as it was. The example on the right is a made-up code.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="vault" data-hidden="true">
      <p class="vault-name">Example vault</p>
      <div class="vault-code" aria-label="Example code, four symbols">
        <img src="assets/symbols/terror.svg" alt="Terror">
        <img src="assets/symbols/admiration.svg" alt="Admiration">
        <img src="assets/symbols/rage.svg" alt="Rage">
        <img src="assets/symbols/amazement.svg" alt="Amazement">
      </div>
      <button class="btn reveal" type="button" data-show="Reveal code" data-hide="Hide again">Reveal code</button>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="safety" aria-labelledby="safety-title">
    <h2 id="safety-title">What it doesn&#x27;t do</h2>
    <ul>
      <li><strong>It doesn&#x27;t touch your files.</strong> Nothing in the game folder or your saves is changed; it reads memory from outside.</li>
      <li><strong>It isn&#x27;t online.</strong> Hell Is Us is a single-player game, and hiumod sends nothing anywhere.</li>
      <li><strong>Cheats are optional.</strong> Health, stamina, speed and a few more are there, all off until you switch them on, written only while you control the hero, and put back when you switch them off.</li>
      <li><strong>It checks the game version.</strong> After a game update it says so instead of guessing, until it&#x27;s been tested again.</li>
    </ul>
  </section>

  <section id="install" class="install" aria-labelledby="install-title">
    <h2 id="install-title">Install in three steps</h2>
    <ol>
      <li><h3>Download</h3><p>Get the latest zip from the Releases page and unpack it anywhere. It only ever writes to the Mods folder in the game directory.</p></li>
      <li><h3>Double-click hiumod.exe</h3><p>It starts the game through Steam if it isn&#x27;t running and attaches once you&#x27;re in. Press ` (the key left of 1) to show or hide the panel. Shift+` opens a console for checking things.</p></li>
      <li><h3>It reads the game once, by itself</h3><p>The first time you control the hero, hiumod reads the game&#x27;s maps and text into the Mods folder on its own (about two minutes). If the .NET 8 runtime is missing, the panel offers to install it.</p></li>
    </ol>
    <a class="btn btn-main" href="https://github.com/myso-kr/hell-is-us-mod/releases/latest">Download for Windows</a>
  </section>

  <section id="faq" class="faq" aria-labelledby="faq-title">
    <h2 id="faq-title">Questions</h2>
    <details><summary>Is there a map in Hell Is Us?</summary><p>No. Hell Is Us deliberately has no map, compass or quest markers. hiumod adds an optional minimap overlay and a quest tracker on PC for players who want one.</p></details>
    <details><summary>Where can I find the vault codes in Hell Is Us?</summary><p>The codes are spread through Hadea as notes and inscriptions. hiumod lists the code for every vault as the game&#x27;s symbols, each hidden until you choose to reveal it.</p></details>
    <details><summary>Can I get banned for using hiumod?</summary><p>Hell Is Us is single-player with no anti-cheat and no online play, and hiumod changes no game files. As with any third-party tool, use it at your own discretion.</p></details>
    <details><summary>Does it work with the latest version of the game?</summary><p>hiumod is tested against a specific Steam build and tells you when the game has been updated since. After an update it reads the game&#x27;s data again by itself; anything that breaks is fixed in a new release.</p></details>
    <details><summary>Which languages does it support?</summary><p>All twelve of the game&#x27;s languages: English, Korean, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Polish, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian and Turkish. It follows the language set in the game.</p></details>
    <details><summary>Is hiumod free?</summary><p>Yes. It&#x27;s free and open source under the MIT license. It&#x27;s a fan project and isn&#x27;t affiliated with Rogue Factor or Nacon.</p></details>
  </section>
</main>
```

```html
    <div class="hero-copy">
      <p class="kicker">Un companion per Hell Is Us · PC</p>
      <h1 id="hero-title">Niente mappa. Niente bussola. A meno che tu non la voglia.</h1>
      <p class="lede">Hadea è fatta per farti perdere. hiumod serve per le sere in cui preferiresti di no: una minimappa in tempo reale, un tracker delle indagini che segue la storia e le risposte alle camere, ognuna nascosta finché non decidi di aprirla.</p>
      <div class="cta">
```
